name: Loaded breakfast burrito
steps: Scramble the eggs in a hot pan with a little oil.
Warm the black beans through and season with salt.
Lay the tortilla flat and pile the eggs and beans down the middle.
Scatter over the grated cheddar and spoon on the salsa.
Fold in the sides and roll into a tight burrito.
Sear the burrito seam-side down until golden.
